promptSummary: Prepare an aged, coarse woven-grass image study for the rolled mat and straw sandals in the approved Sichuan blanket-pack design. Preserve visible woven fibre structure and a worn earthy colour range that remains legible on the low-polygon game asset.
promptSummaryBasis: Design intent and retained source-use script. The exact original imagegen prompt text was not retained; this summary is not a quotation or a reconstruction claimed to be verbatim.

preparation.pixelProcessingRecord: The retained prepared image is authoritative. The exact intermediate pixel-processing recipe was not captured in this provenance record.

use.projection: Part-local physical coordinates; measured circumferential arc on the actual mat roll, local X/Z on sandal sources

normalContribution.source: Prepared tile luminance bump applied to actual high geometry normals
normalContribution.runtimeProjection: True high geometric normals only; source luminance bump is retained for native preview, and temporary BSDF.Normal links are disconnected during final normal projection

use.runtime: Projected from the prepared high-source material into the shared 1024 GameUV PBR set; this source tile is not an additional runtime material
use.materialAdjustment: Fine-scale 55 mm weave, 50 percent retained old-grass colour; warm tint on tile branch only. Original image bytes unchanged.

sourceRetention.note: Keep the original until final source archiving. A later removal of the staged large copy does not change its recorded hash; the tool output path and packed prepared source remain separate provenance.
